title: bug: the daemon records a relative --project or MOE_PROJECT_PATH (the README's terminal-only `moe-daemon init --project .`) verbatim as daemon.json projectPath, /health projectPath and project.json rootPath, so a later start from another folder and the JetBrains plugin both read the live daemon as another project, delete its daemon.json and start a second daemon on the same .moe/
description:
Filed by defect hunt task-3488566e (11-04 #17, lane 2: the JetBrains plugin's daemon spawn/reuse, root cause on the daemon side). HEAD bb0bc17e.

PROBLEM
- packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:67 keeps --project, or MOE_PROJECT_PATH, exactly as typed. :844-850 writes it into daemon.json, /health reports it, and normalizeProject (state/persistence.ts:97, applied at StateManager.ts:1058-1062 on every load) rewrites project.json rootPath to it. index.ts:94-95 already notes that "the daemon records `--project` as given".
- README.md:112 tells terminal-only users to run `moe-daemon init --project .`. The daemon then records projectPath "." and rootPath ".".
- "." names a different directory for every later reader whose cwd differs:
  - The daemon's own start guard (existingDaemonBlocksStart, index.ts:619-625, through validateDaemonInfoForProject/namesOwnProject) run from another folder judges the live daemon stale, logs "Cleaning up stale daemon lifecycle files" and starts a second daemon. The first daemon released its lock once daemon.json was written (index.ts:859), so nothing stops the second one.
  - JetBrains MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt:151-166: isSameProject(".", base) (:970-972; DaemonIdentity.kt:96 collapses "." to "", and File(".").canonicalPath is the IDE's cwd) is false. The plugin skips reuse, deletes the live daemon's daemon.json and spawns its own (:180-203) on project open, reconnect or Restart Daemon.
  - Both plugins compare the STATE_SNAPSHOT rootPath and disconnect on "." (MoeMessageDispatcher.kt:93-98; moe-vscode MoeDaemonClient.ts:1860-1863).
- The result is two daemons writing one .moe/, which breaks the sole-writer invariant. The agent launchers pass an absolute project, so seats alone never trigger it.

EVIDENCE
- Architect re-run on the bb0bc17e snapshot (ports 19886/19887, isolated HOME): /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-3488566e/mine/relative-project-guard-rerun.txt
  live daemon pid=2052204 projectPath=. port=19886; project.json rootPath=.
  (start --project <abs> run from cwd /) WARN: Cleaning up stale daemon lifecycle files ... INFO: Moe daemon running
  daemon.json now: pid 2052253 port 19887 projectPath /tmp/hunt-3488-snap/fixtures/relproj-mine; first pid 2052204 alive: yes
- JetBrains path (Kotlin logic mirrored, no Gradle run): /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-3488566e/A/repro-relative-project.sh and .out, plus kotlin-isSameProject-mirror.mjs.
  isSameProject(".", "/tmp/hunt-3488-A/fixtures/relproj") = false
  daemon.json now: {"port": 19877, "pid": 1937315, ..., "projectPath": "/tmp/hunt-3488-A/fixtures/relproj"}
  first daemon _run pid 1937243 alive: yes; /health on 19876 still: 200

FIX DIRECTION
- In parseArgs (index.ts:59-72), resolve a relative --project or MOE_PROJECT_PATH to an absolute path once, before anything records or compares it.
- Leave POSIX-absolute, drive-letter and UNC values unchanged. moe-proxy/src/utils.ts:39 uses the same rule: `WINDOWS_FORM.test(raw) || raw.startsWith('/') ? raw : path.resolve(raw)`.
- normalizeProject rewrites rootPath from the daemon's project path at every load, so an existing project.json whose rootPath is "." heals at its next start. No client change is needed.
- Out of scope: the JetBrains bindHost probe (a sibling row filed by the same hunt), Kotlin code, the README, docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts, packages/moe-daemon/src/index.test.ts (or a new src/index.relativeProject.test.ts). No open row holds either (lanes.js 06:50Z). The same hunt held back a doctor row (WSL-foreign daemon.json) that wants to move isForeignDaemonInfo/wslGatewayHost out of index.ts; it waits for this row to land.
definitionOfDone: A vitest starts the daemon CLI with `init --project .` from a temp cwd, and once more with MOE_PROJECT_PATH=. and no --project. It asserts that daemon.json projectPath, the /health projectPath and project.json rootPath each equal path.resolve(cwd).

A vitest proves that a second `start --project <absolute path>` run from another cwd while that daemon lives logs 'Moe daemon already running', leaves daemon.json's pid unchanged and starts no second daemon (the case /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-3488566e/A/repro-relative-daemon-guard.sh drives). Absolute POSIX, drive-letter and UNC --project values are recorded unchanged.
`npx vitest run src/index.test.ts` (plus any new test file) passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout, with the run's output as the completion evidence.

implementationPlan.description:
Write the regression test first and prove it RED (TDD). Create packages/moe-daemon/src/index.relativeProject.test.ts with the Write tool. A reference prototype that already ran GREEN and RED is at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-78fa7110/index.relativeProject.test.ts, with the full diff in code.diff next to it. Read it, but never cp it into the tree: a shell write leaves no TOOL witness. Use one describe, and keep these case-title prefixes so QA can grep `> (rN) `:
- (r1) `init --project .` with cwd = a fresh project dir. daemon.json projectPath, the /health projectPath and .moe/project.json rootPath each equal path.resolve(project). [DoD 1]
- (r2) `init` with MOE_PROJECT_PATH='.' and no --project, cwd = the project, over a pre-seeded .moe/project.json `{ id, schemaVersion: CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, name, rootPath: '.' }`, which is what a pre-fix `init --project .` left. The same three values equal path.resolve(project). This also proves a legacy rootPath "." heals at load. [DoD 1, plus the epic's backward-compat rail]
- (r3) With an `init --project .` daemon healthy, run `start --project <absolute project>` from the scratch root (another cwd), with its own free --port and MOE_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS=5000. That env value is a load margin only: the guard's /health probe defaults to 200 ms, and at base the guard fails on 'projectPath mismatch' before it probes. Assert in ONE toEqual, so a RED run shows every field:
  - it exits 0 within 30 s;
  - its JSON log msgs include 'Moe daemon already running', and include neither 'Supervisor spawned daemon process' nor 'Cleaning up stale daemon lifecycle files';
  - daemon.json pid and port are unchanged;
  - /health on the first port still answers the first pid;
  - nothing answers /health on the second port.
  [DoD 2: the case /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-3488566e/A/repro-relative-daemon-guard.sh drives]
- (r4) `init --project <spelled>` run from the scratch root. spelled is `${project}/` on POSIX, and the project with every backslash turned into '/' on win32. All three values equal the spelling exactly. [DoD 2: absolute values are recorded unchanged; scripts/tests/local-runner-channel.test.mjs relies on this]
- (r5) One table over the exported `parseArgs(args, env).projectPath`:
  - '.', 'sub/../proj/', and MOE_PROJECT_PATH '.' and 'proj' give path.resolve(...);
  - MOE_PROJECT_PATH '' gives process.cwd();
  - a --project beats MOE_PROJECT_PATH;
  - '/srv/moe/p/' and '/srv//moe/./p' (also via MOE_PROJECT_PATH), 'D:\\projexts\\app', 'd:/projexts/app/', '\\\\srv\\share\\app' and '//srv/share/app' come back exactly as given, on every OS.
  [DoD 2]

Harness (the shape of index.test.ts 'no-moe start', :951-995):
- Spawn `process.execPath --import <tsx URL> src/index.ts <args>` asynchronously, with NODE_OPTIONS=`--import <tsx URL>`, because the supervisor's _run child needs it. Never use spawnSync while a daemon child holds pipes.
- Scrubbed env: PATH, a scratch HOME and USERPROFILE, NODE_ENV=production (for JSON log lines), plus SystemRoot/TEMP/TMP on win32. No seat MOE_* variable.
- scratch = fs.realpathSync.native(fs.mkdtempSync(...)), because a child's process.cwd() is the real path (the macOS tmpdir is a symlink).
- Explicit free ports, never 9876.
- Wait up to 60 s for daemon.json's pid to answer GET 127.0.0.1:<port>/health.

Error handling in the test:
- A failed or unparseable /health read resolves null; it never throws.
- afterEach has an explicit 60 s hook timeout. It SIGTERMs each supervisor through its own ChildProcess handle (SIGKILL after 12 s).
- It then signals a recorded _run pid only while /health on that pid's recorded port still answers with that pid. On win32, TerminateProcess skips the supervisor's signal forwarding, so the _run can outlive it.
- Last, fs.rmSync(scratch, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5 }).
- No pattern kill, and no pid this test did not spawn or verify.

Budget: about 160 lines; (r5) is table-driven.

Prove RED against the unfixed sources. Base 59e95024 predates the fix:
`cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive 59e95024a08f312e6674ee329c693d6a284b5f7b packages/moe-daemon | tar -x -C "$S" && cp --parents packages/moe-daemon/src/index.relativeProject.test.ts "$S" && cd "$S/packages/moe-daemon" && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 && { NO_COLOR=1 npx vitest run src/index.relativeProject.test.ts > "$S/l" 2>&1; grep -aE "^ +Tests |^ FAIL " "$S/l"; }`
The prototype gave `Tests  4 failed | 1 passed (5)`:
- (r1) and (r2) record '.';
- (r3) shows a second daemon (cleaned: true, new pid and port) after its 30 s wait;
- (r5) fails with 'parseArgs is not a function';
- (r4) passes at base by design, because it guards the absolute path.
Put that Tests line in the completion summary.

implementationPlan.description:
Implement the fix: resolve a relative project path once, in parseArgs.

1. packages/moe-daemon/src/util/projectPath.ts. Below the MNT_DRIVE constant, add `export function absoluteProjectPath(projectPath: string): string`. It returns `WINDOWS_FORM.test(projectPath) || projectPath.startsWith('/') ? projectPath : path.resolve(projectPath)`, which is moe-proxy/src/utils.ts:39's rule. Give it a 3-line doc comment: this is the value the daemon records in daemon.json, /health and project.json rootPath; a relative value is resolved once against the cwd because every later reader has its own cwd; a POSIX-absolute, drive or UNC value is kept as given.
   Then make comparableProjectPath reuse it: replace its two lines (`const raw = …trim()` and `const abs = … ? raw : path.resolve(raw)`) with `const abs = absoluteProjectPath(projectPath.trim());`. This is behavior-identical: index.test.ts X1/X9/X10/X15 pin it, and scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs keeps comparing the daemon and proxy dists.

2. packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts.
   - Import absoluteProjectPath on the :28 line.
   - Change `function parseArgs()` to `function parseArgs(args: string[] = process.argv.slice(2), env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env)`, and drop the `const args = …` line.
   - Read MOE_PROJECT_PATH and MOE_BIND_HOST from `env`.
   - Write `const projectPath = absoluteProjectPath(projectIndex >= 0 ? args[projectIndex + 1] : env.MOE_PROJECT_PATH || process.cwd());`.
   - Add parseArgs to the export block (:1304). main() keeps calling parseArgs() with no arguments.
   - Rewrite the sentence at :94-95 in isForeignDaemonInfo's doc comment: only a daemon before task-78fa7110 recorded a relative projectPath, and such a path still names no side.

3. packages/moe-daemon/src/index.test.ts:316. Change only the X2 comment, the same way. The X2 rows stay.

Nothing else changes. These already take parseArgs's projectPath:
- daemon.json (:844-853);
- /health (:760);
- the supervisor's `_run --project` (:973);
- initProject's rootPath (:1199);
- the lock (:232).
normalizeProject (state/persistence.ts:97, persisted by StateManager.ts:1058-1066) also rewrites rootPath from it at every load.

Error handling and compatibility:
- An absolute value is never touched. Launchers, both IDE plugins, Docker (MOE_PROJECT_PATH=/project) and local-runner-channel's spelled start therefore record exactly what they recorded before.
- Never apply canonicalProjectPath or path.resolve to an absolute value. It strips a trailing '/', and on win32 it turns '/' into a backslash and prefixes the cwd drive.
- A trailing `--project` with no value still fails the command with exit 1 through main's catch ('Fatal error'), as before. Do not default it to the cwd.
- Keep the index.ts hunks local to parseArgs, the import, the export block and the one comment. task-d7b24cab (BACKLOG, waits on this row) will later move isForeignDaemonInfo/wslGatewayHost out of index.ts.
implementationPlan.note: Added absoluteProjectPath to util/projectPath.ts (comparableProjectPath reuses it, behavior-identical); parseArgs(args, env) wraps the project value in it and is now exported; main() still calls parseArgs() with no args. Two comments updated (isForeignDaemonInfo doc, index.test.ts X2). Diff is 3 files +18/-10 plus the new test file. grep shows no other raw MOE_PROJECT_PATH read in index.ts; the remaining process.argv reads are the accounts/check-architecture/script-path commands.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of this task's diff (the four files only). Read it as an attacker:
- Absolute spellings untouched? (r4) and (r5) cover it. Grep that no other index.ts line now runs canonicalProjectPath or path.resolve on the parsed value.
- One entry point? `grep -n "MOE_PROJECT_PATH\|process.argv" packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts` must show no second raw read. The `accounts` and `check-architecture` argv reads are separate commands.
- Empty and odd inputs: `--project ''` resolves to the cwd. MOE_PROJECT_PATH '' falls back to the cwd. A trailing `--project` still exits 1 and is not defaulted. On win32, `C:x` and a single-backslash root are relative and resolve on the cwd drive.
- Concurrency: two starts of one project from different cwds now record and lock the same absolute path (acquireLock already writes canonicalProjectPath).
- Legacy: a daemon.json that a pre-fix daemon wrote with '.' is still judged local (the X2 rows are unchanged). A pre-fix daemon that is still running keeps its '.' file until it restarts; that is out of scope, so say it in the summary.
- Runner key: runnerKeyPath is sha256(projectPath), so a project once started relative gets a fresh key under the absolute name at its next start. verified-local stays refused, and the local-runner client reads the key by the daemon's reported spelling.
- Test hygiene:
  - after the gate, `ps -eo pid,args | grep -F "$S/packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts"` is empty. This is a read-only check, never a kill by pattern;
  - no fixture outside os.tmpdir();
  - the test file type-checks: put a scratch tt.json in the snapshot's packages/moe-daemon, `{"extends":"./tsconfig.json","compilerOptions":{"noEmit":true,"types":["node"]},"include":["src/index.relativeProject.test.ts"],"exclude":[]}`, then `npx tsc -p tt.json` (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate).
- No new daemon source comment may match util/daemonGitDocs.test.ts's git-claim regex (same memory).
- Explicit error handling is present on every new path: the /health helper, cleanup, and the missing value.
- Budget: at most about 200 net LOC. The prototype was +179/-10.
- If this review changes any byte, re-run step 3's exact command and use that fresh output as the evidence.
- Background: mem:gotcha-daemon-lifecycle-wsl-foreign, mem:decision-project-path-comparison-contract.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
(1) Apply path.resolve / canonicalProjectPath to every --project value. Rejected:
- it rewrites absolute spellings: it strips a trailing '/', and on win32 it turns '/' into a backslash and gives a POSIX path a drive;
- that changes what launchers record, and breaks scripts/tests/local-runner-channel.test.mjs, whose spelled start relies on daemon.json, /health and the runner key name carrying the spelling as given. The prototype's mutant m1 fails (r4) and (r5).
(2) Teach the readers to interpret a recorded '.' (the start guard, JetBrains isSameProjectPath, the STATE_SNAPSHOT rootPath checks). Rejected: '.' has no anchor, and every reader has its own cwd.
(3) Resolve only in startDaemon. Rejected: initProject's rootPath, the supervisor's guard and its `_run --project` argument, the lock and the logs run before _run or outside it. parseArgs is the single entry point for --project and MOE_PROJECT_PATH.
Chosen: moe-proxy's own rule (utils.ts:39), extracted as util/projectPath.ts absoluteProjectPath and shared with comparableProjectPath, so recording and comparing cannot drift.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
Prototype: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-78fa7110/code.diff (+179/-10), run in a git-archive snapshot of HEAD 59e95024 with a native npm ci:
- GREEN: tsc clean, the test file type-checks, and the gate gives 78 passed | 1 skipped (79) in about 6 s.
- RED at base: 4 failed | 1 passed (5). (r3) shows the bug exactly: cleaned true, a second _run pid on another port, the first still healthy.
- Mutants: resolving every value fails (r4) and (r5). Leaving MOE_PROJECT_PATH unresolved fails (r5) only. In that case the supervisor hands `_run --project <value>` to its child, which re-parses it, so (r2) alone cannot see the env path; (r5) is what pins it.
- No leaked processes after any run.

Facts:
- Daemon starts through tsx take about 0.8 s each here.
- vitest.config.ts blanks MOE_PROJECT_PATH in process.env, so the CLI children get an explicit scrubbed env, and r5 passes env to parseArgs.
- normalizeProject always sets rootPath to the daemon's projectPath, and StateManager persists it when it differs. That heals a legacy rootPath '.'; (r2) proves it.
- No doc claims that a relative value is recorded as given. README.md:112's `init --project .` advice simply starts working, so there is no doc change.
- Lanes at 07:0xZ: no open row declares index.ts, index.test.ts or util/projectPath.ts.
planningNotes.risks:
- An already-running pre-fix daemon keeps its '.' daemon.json until it restarts. This row does not heal it.
- Windows:
  - test cleanup must verify a _run pid by /health before signalling it, because TerminateProcess skips the supervisor's forwarding;
  - the (r4) spelling uses forward slashes;
  - (r5) expects POSIX-absolute values unchanged on win32 too, per the shared contract.
- Load: give (r3)'s second start MOE_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS=5000. Keep the 60 s afterEach hook timeout; the default is 10 s, below the 12 s SIGKILL fallback.
- At base, (r3) takes about 31 s because of its 30 s wait. That is expected in the RED run only.
- runnerKeyPath = sha256(projectPath): a project once started relative mints a new key under the absolute name. verified-local is refused, so no client depends on the old key.
- task-d7b24cab waits on this row and moves isForeignDaemonInfo out of index.ts. Keep the hunks local.
